description: This file is a Streamlit application script for a medical exam preparation chatbot that uses Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) approach. It sets up the UI, manages session state, loads chapters and conversation history, and defines an async function to generate answers based on textbook content retrieved from a vector store, integrating OpenAI's API.

methods.name: generate_rag_answer
methods.description: Asynchronously generates an answer to a question using a RAG approach by embedding the question, retrieving relevant textbook chunks from a vector store, and querying OpenAI's API with the combined context.
